decision_reason: Iteration 1 returned strong signals from high-authority sources (UNICEF SitRep covering 20 Aug–1 Sep 2024, WHO DON 2024-DON522, ReliefWeb-hosted DRC sitrep No. 025 dated 29 August 2024, INRB result, ECDC, Africa CDC-adjacent sources). However, the snippets are metadata-only — no page text was fetched — so numeric fields (cases_confirmed, cases_probable, cases_suspected, deaths, subnational_location, locality) cannot yet be populated from iteration 1 alone. Key gaps remain: (1) The DRC national sitrep series (sitrep No. 025 and adjacent weekly sitreps covering epidemiological weeks 31–35 of 2024) needs to be surfaced more completely, including earlier August sitreps (e.g., sitrep No. 022–024); (2) Africa CDC published dedicated August 2024 Mpox situation reports that were not prominently represented in iteration 1 results; (3) WHO AFRO multi-country external situation reports specifically covering epidemiological weeks 31–35 (August 2024) were not directly surfaced — the cdn.who.int result was sitrep No. 57 from August 2025, not August 2024; (4) Hospitalization data and health-zone-level (locality) breakdowns are likely only in INRB/Ministry of Health French bulletins, which appeared only once (inrb.cd, 1 result) without a confirming snippet. A second iteration of 4 targeted queries can close these gaps within the 10-query total budget (4 used + 4 new = 8 ≤ 10).
coverage_assessment: Iteration 1 surfaced strong candidate sources across international organizations (WHO, UNICEF, ECDC, CDC) and one INRB/ReliefWeb French-language sitrep. The UNICEF SitRep (20 Aug–1 Sep 2024) snippet contains a partial aggregate figure (20,015 suspected cases, 632 deaths as of week 35) but this is a year-to-date cumulative figure, not an August-only monthly total. The ReliefWeb sitrep No. 025 (29 Aug 2024) is the most directly relevant national source but only appeared as a title/URL — no numeric content was confirmed. WHO DON 2024-DON522 covers the DRC outbreak context but its snippet does not contain August 2024 case counts. The PMC article on Kokolo health zone (Kinshasa) covers August–November 2024 and could provide locality-level data. Africa CDC was not represented in the top results despite being a primary source for weekly African Mpox data. WHO AFRO external situation reports for August 2024 (sitrep nos. covering epi weeks 31–35) were not directly surfaced. Coverage is promising but incomplete for the target fields.
source_diversity_assessment: Domains represented: unicef.org (1), reliefweb.int (5), cdn.who.int (2), who.int (3), cdc.gov (1), doctorswithoutborders.org (2), facebook.com (2 — low trust), pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov (1), inrb.cd (1), msf.ch (1), ecdc.europa.eu (1), nicd.ac.za (1), and several minor domains. Good diversity across international organizations and NGOs. Missing: africacdc.org (Africa CDC) direct results, WHO AFRO weekly situation reports for August 2024 specifically, and additional INRB/DRC Ministry of Health French bulletins covering the full August 2024 window (sitreps 022–024 in addition to 025).
trustworthiness_assessment: High-trust sources identified: WHO DON (who.int), UNICEF SitRep (unicef.org), ReliefWeb-hosted DRC sitrep No. 025 (reliefweb.int, sourced from DRC Ministry of Health/INRB), ECDC (ecdc.europa.eu), INRB (inrb.cd), CDC HAN (cdc.gov), PMC peer-reviewed article (pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov). Medium-trust: MSF/Doctors Without Borders (operational context, not primary surveillance data), NETEC (secondary summary). Low-trust: facebook.com posts (not usable as primary evidence). The facebook.com results should be excluded from evidence extraction. The ReliefWeb sitrep No. 025 and INRB result are the highest-priority targets for August 2024 subnational data.
disease_location_time_fit_assessment: Disease fit: Strong — all top results are explicitly about Mpox/monkeypox in DRC. Location fit: Strong — DRC is the primary focus of all top results. Time fit: Partial — the UNICEF SitRep covers 20 Aug–1 Sep 2024 (fits), ReliefWeb sitrep No. 025 is dated 29 Aug 2024 (fits), WHO DON 2024-DON522 covers the ongoing outbreak context (partially fits), but the cdn.who.int result (sitrep No. 57) is from August 2025 (does not fit the target window). Several results are general outbreak context without August 2024-specific case counts. The ReliefWeb sitrep No. 025 and adjacent sitreps (covering epi weeks 31–35) are the best time-fit sources not yet fully surfaced.
corroboration_potential_assessment: The DRC national sitrep series (sitrep No. 025 and adjacent) can corroborate WHO AFRO aggregate figures. The UNICEF SitRep aggregate (20,015 suspected, 632 deaths as of week 35) can be cross-checked against WHO AFRO weekly situation reports for the same period. The PMC Kokolo article provides locality-level corroboration for Kinshasa. Africa CDC weekly briefs (not yet surfaced) would provide independent corroboration of DRC case counts. A second iteration targeting these specific gaps will substantially improve corroboration potential.
